'''Mikel de Sa Gomes''' (born 6 July 1990) is an Andorran [[Sprint (running)|sprinter]].<ref name="Bio">{{cite web |url=http://www.iaaf.org/athletes/andorra/mikel-de-sa-270665 |title=Mikel de Sa |accessdate=20 August 2013 |work=IAAF}}</ref> He competed in the [[2013 World Championships in Athletics – Men's 100 metres|100 metres]] event at the [[2013 World Championships in Athletics]].<ref name="Athletes">{{cite web |url=http://www.iaaf.org/competitions/iaaf-world-championships/14th-iaaf-world-championships-4873/athletes?country=AND |title=Andorra at the 2013 World Championships in Athletics |accessdate=20 August 2013 |work=IAAF}}</ref> He currently holds the Andorran record on the 100 meters outdoor U23, setting 11"20 in [[Barcelona]] in 2012.<ref name="Record">{{cite web|url=http://www.faa.ad/images/docs/records/records_%202012_outdoor.pdf|title=RECORDS D'ANDORRA D'AIRE LLIURE|accessdate=24 November 2013|work=FAA|url-status=dead|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20150924005321/http://www.faa.ad/images/docs/records/records_%202012_outdoor.pdf|archivedate=24 September 2015|df=dmy-all}}</ref>
